applied.land_manager: The BLM Monticello Field Office manages the Indian Creek corridor; the office is at 365 N Main and the phone is 435-587-1500. Hwy 211 is the way in, 26 miles of it. Moab lies 40 miles to the north of the corridor, and Monticello is 15 miles to the south.
applied.fees: Hamburger Rock, Superbowl and Creek Pasture campgrounds are first come, first served at $15 per night with a 14-day stay limit. Reservable group sites hold up to 50 people at $65 per night. No climbing permit is listed.
applied.rules: Raptor closures run March through late summer and name The Wall, Far Side and Cat Wall; areas cleared by the surveys in late April or early May reopen, so check the closure notices before climbing. Protect cryptobiotic soil and archaeological sites.
